description: This file defines the UploadedFileFactory class which implements the UploadedFileFactoryInterface. It provides a method to create instances of UploadedFile, taking in a stream and optional parameters for size, error status, filename, and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating UploadedFile instances in accordance with PSR-17.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates and returns an UploadedFile instance using provided stream and optional metadata.
